conditions: The four named inputs are complete ordered action tables on every history. For each table, positive-depth IC rows are regenerated from the same policy's true changed-history continuation; the selected root action is allowed to violate root IC and is relaxed by Delta >= delta. Customer-type masses x_M are nonnegative, W=1, and every comparison support J has size min(m,p).

roles.CA-STRATEGY-CONE: Provides the exact interpretation of all ordered-history IC rows as a nonnegative rational customer-multiplicity cone, the W=1 slice, integer-clone meaning, and fixed-(sigma,J) primal/dual certificate semantics.
roles.customer-attraction/positive-depth-root-: Specializes that cone semantics to four saved full policies, all actual roots and all min(m,p)-supports, adding the explicit root-regret payment coordinate Delta and replaying 230 sparse rational primal/dual certificates.

explanation: For each fixed policy sigma, the computation's G rows are exactly the positive-depth ordered-history payoff differences from the cone theorem, while each root row is the same difference with a unit Delta coefficient. The saved checker rebuilds terminal counts and row ordering from every history, then verifies each sparse x, each nonnegative dual multiplier vector mu, all customer-type residuals, the Delta residual, and equality of objective and beta. Thus the four finite cones have exact maxima 7/4, 3/2, 33/23 and 9/8 over 90, 16, 120 and 4 targets respectively. Delta equals the actual root regret in every record (228 zero-regret records; two fractional-root records with Delta=delta=1/24).
scope: Only the four declared complete policies, their p possible actual roots, and all supports J of size min(m,p), with W=1 plus the explicitly checked W=0 boundary. The result is not a bound over arbitrary complete strategies, arbitrary m or p, or a universal root-regret/half-coverage theorem.

contribution.result: The general fixed-policy cone semantics specialize to an exact finite paid-root-regret audit: every saved primal/dual pair is rationally feasible and optimal, and every certified value is <=2, so no one of these 230 cones supplies OPT-2W>3delta.
contribution.remaining: The threefold compiler, integer replay to a half counterexample, and any quantification over policies or catalog sizes remain outside this edge. The two Delta=1/24 records are not complete-root SPEs; they only certify positive-depth IC with paid root regret.
